introduction:
My Lyrics is designed as a local songbook reader. We value your privacy
        and keep the app simple: it does not collect, store, transmit, or share
        personal information.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.html:
We do not collect personal information from users. The app does not
        require an account, and the app does not access, collect, store, or
        share user data with us.

sections.title: Your Songbook Content
sections.html:
Songbook files that you import are used by the app so it can display
        your lyrics and books. That content remains under your control on your
        device or in your browser's local storage when using the web demo.

sections.title: Information We Share
sections.html:
Since we do not collect personal information, we do not share personal
        information with third parties.

sections.title: Cookies and Tracking
sections.html:
The My Lyrics app does not use cookies or tracking technologies. The
        GitHub Pages support website is a static site and does not add analytics
        or advertising trackers.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.html:
The app does not use third-party services or software that collect user
        information for us. The support website and web demo are hosted on
        GitHub Pages, which may process basic technical request data according
        to GitHub's own policies.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.html:
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make changes,
        we will update the effective date on this page.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.html: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at laurelltm@gmail.com.
